title: Art & Sol Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in the heart of Seagrove and steps to the beach, Art & Sol is an updated and recently renovated townhome in the community of Cassine Gardens.
description_expanded: HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - Beautiful views from back balconies - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - Walking distance to several shops and restaurants - Community grill - Wifi and streaming TVs - Fully stocked kitchen complete with Keurig and standard drip coffee maker - Community pool and tennis court - Short 5-minute walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. ADDITIONAL ADD-ONS -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($100 fee applies at booking) HOME DETAILS: Located in the heart of Seagrove and steps to the beach, Art+Sol is a renovated 2BR/1.5BA townhome in the community of Cassine Gardens. Art+Sol offers an updated kitchen with granite countertops, new appliances, and tile. Industrial grade, sand, salt and water friendly faux wood flooring throughout. Enjoy peaceful privacy and sounds of nature from the first and second floor screened porches overlooking the Cypress Pond. Art & Sol sits just steps to the community pool as well as the Cassine Garden Trailhead which connects to the Eastern Lake Trail System! The beach is just a short walk with access at One Seagrove. Enjoy a morning hike or fishing along the pond, an afternoon at the beach and an evening dip in the from the tranquil doorsteps of Art+Sol. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 6) First Floor: Open living, kitchen and dining area along with a 1/2 bath, private screened porch with washer and dryer. Second Floor: Bedroom 1: King bed, flat screen TV private balcony with beautiful view Bedroom 2: sleeps 4- Queen bed, set of Twin XL bunks with built in reading lamps and charging ports in each bunk Hallway Shared full Bath (tub/shower combo) **Golf carts are allowed in this community. Call for an exclusive daily rate discount for being a Sandpiper guest. **Sorry! This property is not pet friendly. FREE WIFI Certificate #113328 / TDT #39156

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
